title: Hermann Oberth on video about UFOs
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Hermann Oberth on video about UFOs, about an unknown time at an unknown place, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Herman Oberth is on video speculating about UFOs. He says, you know, the the existence of UFOs should make anybody question reality.
After so many witnesses have seen the so-called flying saucers, their existence cannot longer be denied. I believe that these flying objects come from another solar system.
tellings.difference: Quotes Oberth himself saying the saucers can't be denied and come from another solar system, where the story has him saying UFOs should make anyone question reality.
tellings.link_reason: Both are Oberth's own recorded statement speculating about UFOs.

as_told.title: Oberth: flying saucers come from another solar system

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that Hermann Oberth, one of the founding pioneers of rocket science, was recorded on video speculating about UFOs. According to Michels, Oberth said that the existence of UFOs should make anybody question reality, a striking thing to hear from a serious scientist.
